proprio: current boundary state8, equal within Clean/Shift pair
x_probe: reuse saved common [1,12,7] tensor; assert hashes equal across states
z0_scope: one fixed tensor for all observations, not an extra rollout seed
metrics: Resampler per-view token RMS and pooled L2
same-x velocity RMS and hidden L2
full official sampled controller action difference before/after clipping
between-state distance at shared boundary steps
separation_scope: descriptive distances, no shared cross-state physical-action histories and no ACPC theorem/IR/SR claim
aggregation: within-state boundary mean/median, then equal initial-state mean; no inferential CI from two states
acceptance: correctness and finite outputs, not an effectiveness threshold
